description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to process container management, including network interfaces, memory, CPU info, and container lifecycle operations within the Thunder::ProcessContainers namespace.

classes.name: INetworkInterfaceIterator
classes.description: Interface for iterating network interfaces, providing methods to get interface name, number of addresses, and specific IP address.

classes.name: IMemoryInfo
classes.description: Interface for retrieving memory usage statistics of a container.

classes.name: IProcessorInfo
classes.description: Interface for retrieving CPU usage information of a container.

classes.name: IContainerIterator
classes.description: Interface for iterating over containers, providing access to container IDs.

classes.name: IContainer
classes.description: Interface representing a container, with methods to get its type, ID, PID, memory, CPU info, network interfaces, and control methods to start and stop the container.

classes.name: IContainerProducer
classes.description: Interface for creating and managing container instances, including initialization, deinitialization, and container creation.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts a container with a specified command and parameters.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops a running container with a specified timeout.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the container producer with a configuration.

methods.name: Container
methods.description: Creates a new container with specified ID, search paths, log path, and configuration.
